statement: Chaotic Troll is at the end of World 4 in the map Enclave of Eyes
Chaotic Troll only requires 900 Accuracy for 100% hit chance
During the boss fight you may have to fight other World 4 mobs up to and including the Stilted Seeker
Stilted Seeker requires 16.5k Accuracy for 100% hit chance
Each Chaotic Troll attempt requires five Troll Enclave keys
Stilted Seekers drop keys at a 1 in 15000 chance per kill
Easiest way to get keys is to be offline while fighting Stilted Seekers
After 15000 offline kills you get a guaranteed key drop
Another key source is the World 4 colosseum in the map TV Outpost
Mutated Mush miniboss has a 1 in 2 drop chance for a Troll Key
Chaotic Troll has about 350 million HP
You must attack the boss before anything happens to start the fight
Boss's only ability creates a random task to complete before you can damage him; there are 11 task options
If you fail the task the boss heals
A task starts after you attack him two to three times
Loot Dice task: roll a 6 to be able to attack him; if you fail wait for next task
Task: kill the monster closest to the middle of the screen; tricky if you multi-hit
Task: kill 10 monsters without hurting any Green Mushrooms
Take off your weapon to single hit monsters or be careful what you attack because mushrooms get in the way
Task: avoid all red circles on the ground; no damage for a few seconds lets you fight
Troll Scales are used to craft World 4 armor
You must complete different Merit Board tasks to unlock crafting this armor
The World 4 armor is pretty good
Jagged Obol of Massive Trolling drops from Chaotic Troll at 1 in 1250
Obol gives 9 to all base stats and 10 defense plus 3% misc bonus to all stats
It is a good obol to collect at least one of
Other drops are standard rare drop tables
